article.title: 12 More Highlights from Rick Rubin's "The Creative Act: A Way of Being"
article.previewText: "Defining one’s true self is not so simple. It may be impossible. We inhabit many different versions of a changing self. The suggestion to be yourself may be too general to be of much use. . .
